title: Deliver Oil to Fort Slarningwell Oil Refinery
briefing:
You run a young transport company. A customer needs **Oil** delivered to **Fort Slarningwell Oil Refinery** (industry id 13, near tile 107,73).

A likely supplier is **Bendwood Oil Wells** (industry id 6, near tile 113,55); any source counts, only what your company delivers to that industry is counted.

**Contract:** deliver at least **240 units** within the horizon.

If you conclude the contract cannot be met by anyone, say so with `rh abstain reason="..."`; abstaining on a feasible contract scores zero.

The reward is the fraction of the contract delivered (capped at 1), measured by the engine.
